item.title: Analysts Foresee Lower New Car Sales In Malaysia This Year

item.title: Salaam Cola Malaysia, JPC to Host RM25,000 ‘Salaam Movement: Padel Tournament Edition’ in February

item.title: Trader loses over RM277,000 due to non-existent investment
item.description: KUANTAN: A trader lost more than RM277,000 after being deceived by non-existent investments offered via the WhatsApp application. Pahang Police Chief Datuk Seri Yahaya Othman said the 52-year-old man initially met a woman through the application before being offered an investment that promised high returns in a short period of time. item.title: TNB Wins Top Honours at National Corporate Governance & Sustainability Awards 2025
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Tenaga Nasional Berhad (TNB) has once again affirmed its leadership in corporate governance and sustainability after being recognised in two prestigious categories at the National Corporate Governance & Sustainability Awards 2025. TNB received the Overall Excellence Award (Top 10) and the Industry Excellence Award (Utilities), marking a significant achievement in its ongoing efforts to uphold the highest standards of transparency, accountability and responsible leadership.
